findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: feed_archive, reports_index · Private data: platform_stats, trending, funding_rates, liquidations, market_heatmap, narratives, burn_tracker, sentiment_history, funding_rates_history, whale_daily_summary, social_summary, whale_activity, analysts, analysts_signals, analysts_signals_all, analysts_top, analyst_archive, whale_movements, feed_archive, golden_alerts_snapshot, golden_alerts_history, golden_alerts_monthly, whale_monthly_archive, fear_greed_monthly, sentiment_monthly, funding_rate_monthly, analyst_top_tokens, arbitrage_history, analyst_daily_summary, analyst_summary_history, arbitrage_monthly, leverage_history, leverage_picks_summary, leverage_radar, market_pulse_history, gas_price_history, narrative_history, bridge_flow_history, whale_score_history, fear_greed_history · Public sink: reports_index.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: feed_archive, reports_index · Private data: platform_stats, trending, funding_rates, liquidations, market_heatmap, narratives, burn_tracker, sentiment_history, funding_rates_history, whale_daily_summary, social_summary, whale_activity, analysts, analysts_signals, analysts_signals_all, analysts_top, analyst_archive, whale_movements, feed_archive, golden_alerts_snapshot, golden_alerts_history, golden_alerts_monthly, whale_monthly_archive, fear_greed_monthly, sentiment_monthly, funding_rate_monthly, analyst_top_tokens, arbitrage_history, analyst_daily_summary, analyst_summary_history, arbitrage_monthly, leverage_history, leverage_picks_summary, leverage_radar, market_pulse_history, gas_price_history, narrative_history, bridge_flow_history, whale_score_history, fear_greed_history · Public sink: reports_index

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
